Purpose: To decide, from recorded signals only, among choices that are already fixed. The router runs
Caller and time: The engine and a loop layer, at three decision points inside a phase attempt.

rows: The order of, and exclusions among, entries of the frozen check manifest of the phase
Adds a command or builds an argument list
A registered loop layer, or off for this phase attempt
Switches a layer on; replaces the gated loop
The next rung of the pinned model-tier ladder of the same harness, or `skip` with a reason
Moves to another harness; targets a rung that equals a critic-class call of the run in model and in effort (signal `targetIsCriticModel`)

Inputs: The decision point; signals (counts, exit codes, the failure signature as the ordered list of
failed command ids with their exit codes, tree fingerprints, measured durations, caps left, the state of the limit window of the target of an escalation);
configuration; the model-tier ladder. Never task prose, output of a check or anything a model
Outputs: The choice, the id of the rule that fired, the signals, the table version.
Errors: A table without a default row for a decision point fails validation at load.
Guarantees of the core: One function evaluates the table, with no I/O, no clock and no model. Once a loop layer is engaged in the phase attempt, every decision is an event
(`route.decided`), including one that changes nothing. No routing decision reaches the critic.
Choosing the proposer and the critic is role resolution and not routing.
Guarantees of an implementation: For every vector of signals exactly one row fires. A row holds a rule id, a predicate over named
signals and a choice from the closed choice set of its decision point.
Failure of an implementation: An invalid table switches routing off for the run, announced, and `route.decided` carries the rule
id `config-off`. The loop then runs in manifest order, on the base model tier, with the pinned layer.
Unknown-value rule: An unknown decision point, an unknown signal name and a choice outside the choice set each make the
Wave 1 implementations: The shipped table. A loop layer contributes the rows of the decision points it consults.
Proving test: Golden decisions per row. The property that exactly one row fires for every vector of signals. The
sample layer of EP-04 adds a decision point with two rows, and the engine is unchanged.
